title: Person1IncidentPayloadContract
description: Standardized JSON payload contract ingested by Person 1 Logic App Orchestrator and passed to Network Containment Azure Function.

IncidentID.description: Unique identifier for the security incident, used as Partition Key in Cosmos DB.

TargetVM.description: Full Azure ARM Resource ID of the target virtual machine to isolate.

IPAddress.description: Public or private IP address associated with the compromised VM.

SubscriptionID.description: Azure Subscription ID where the target VM resides.

IncidentSeverity.description: Severity level of the alert. Network containment executes only when set to High or Critical.

ResourceGroupName.description: Optional explicit Azure Resource Group name containing the target VM.
